meta.name: pua-loop
meta.description: PUA Loop — autonomous iterative development with autoresearch-style gate protocol. Runs FOREVER until verified done. Oracle Isolation: hook independently verifies completion, Claude cannot lie. Triggers on: '/pua:pua-loop', '自动循环', 'loop mode', '一直跑', '自动迭代'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动迭代开发直到验证通过
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望开发过程自动循环直到任务完成
copy.tagline_en: Iterate development automatically until verified done
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want development to loop automatically until completion

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会进入自动迭代开发模式：不断执行任务、自我验证，直到外部验证命令确认完成才停止。Claude 不能撒谎说“做完了”，必须由验证程序说了算。
howto.when: 当你说出“/pua:pua-loop”、“自动循环”、“loop mode”、“一直跑”或“自动迭代”等触发词时启动。

say.text: 自动循环，帮我写一个Python爬虫，直到测试通过。
say.note: Claude 会反复修改代码并运行验证，直到通过。

say.text: 一直跑，优化这个SQL查询，直到性能提升50%。
say.note: Claude 会迭代优化，每次用验证命令检查性能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude enters autonomous iterative development mode: it repeatedly executes tasks and self-verifies until an external verification command confirms completion. Claude cannot claim 'done' without passing the oracle check.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say '/pua:pua-loop', '自动循环', 'loop mode', '一直跑', or '自动迭代'.

say_en.text: Loop mode, write a Python crawler until tests pass.
say_en.note: Claude will iteratively modify code and run verification until success.

say_en.text: Keep running, optimize this SQL query until performance improves by 50%.
say_en.note: Claude will iterate and check performance with each cycle.
